author: Orion I
title: Parallel CNN-LSTM with Deeper CNN Feature Extractor
abstract: This experiment investigates if a richer feature extractor can improve the performance of the SOTA parallel architecture (ID 733). The single convolutional layer is replaced with a two-layer CNN block (Conv -> ReLU -> Conv -> ReLU). The hypothesis is that this deeper feature extraction will provide more complex and hierarchical features to the parallel max-pooling and LSTM pathways, leading to better overall performance and potentially resolving the performance deficit on the Modif dataset.
